_doc: Per-dataset state/action conventions shown on the dataset page (/api/sources/{sid}/conventions). Curated from the real files on S3 (2026-11-01); 'verified' says what was checked, 'unverified' rows say what was not. A string value is an alias to another entry. LeRobot sources also get their info.json feature names/dims attached live by the API.

raiden.frame: Joint space, one 7-D vector per arm (two YAM arms, each in its own base frame); robot_data.npz keeps the arms separate, policies concatenate [L 7, R 7] = 14-D. Gripper normalised 0-1, 1 = open (episodes start at ~0.99).
raiden.verified: robot_data.npz + metadata.json of tri-yam/raw/tie_rope/russet_2026-04-08T10-55-02 (keys, shapes, ranges, rate). Effort unit not checked.

axes: measured follower arm joints, base to wrist
commanded follower joints (tracks the leader arm)
teleop leader arm; effort unit unverified

yam.frame: Joint space per arm from the Foxglove MCAP: RobotState (6 joints) + GripperState (1) per arm, each arm in its own base frame. Gripper 0-1, 1 = open (episodes start at ~0.97).
yam.rate: proprio ~290 Hz (22.4k messages over 2.3k camera frames), cameras 30 fps

abc130k.frame: Joint space per arm from the MCAP: RobotState (6 joints) + GripperState (1), each arm in its own base frame; the Argus LeRobot copy (abc130k_v3ar) carries the same values as joint_state 14-D [L j1-6, L grip, R j1-6, R grip] (block layout, not interleaved) plus a 20-D end-effector state. Gripper 0-1, 1 = open.
abc130k.rate: state ~290 Hz, action ~200 Hz in the MCAP; cameras 30 fps (LeRobot copy resampled to 30 Hz)
abc130k.verified: MCAP summary + first messages of train/arrange_the_flowers_into_the_vase/episode_01126762...; abc130k_v3ar t000 info.json, stats.json and episode 0 (joint_state matches the MCAP values). EE rot6d row/column order unverified.

axes: L / R tcp x y z
end-effector position in that arm's base frame
6-D rotation (two rows/columns of R, order unverified)

worldengine.frame: Joint space, 14-D [L 6 joints, L gripper, R 6 joints, R gripper], absolute positions; names from info.json. State gripper 0-1, 1 = open (episode 0 starts at 0.999).
worldengine.verified: info.json + stats.json + episode 0 of accessory-return. stats.json gives the action gripper range 0-0.08 while episode 0 reads 1.0: action gripper scale unverified.

axes: waist, shoulder, elbow, forearm_roll, wrist_angle, wrist_rotate

molmoact2_yam.frame: Joint space, 14-D [L joint_0-5, L gripper, R joint_0-5, R gripper], absolute positions; names from info.json. Gripper 0-1, 1 = open (inferred).
molmoact2_yam.verified: info.json + stats.json at the repo root. Gripper polarity not checked on an episode.

realomni.frame: Egocentric UMI (robot_type umi_bimanual): two hand-held grippers, no robot or base. End-effector space, absolute poses; position origin = midpoint of the two TCPs at frame 0 (frame 0 left = -right), axes from the SLAM map (orientation not identity at start). action equals observation.state (identical stats). fraction_open 0-1, 1 = open.
realomni.verified: info.json + stats.json of realomin_s1 / s3, episode 0 of s1. 'Midpoint origin' read off one episode; rot6d row/column order unverified; whether action is the same frame or the next frame unverified.

axes: gripper TCP position (spans several m: the operator walks)
left / right cam x y z

droid.frame: Single Franka Panda. observation.state / action are end-effector (robot base frame); joint_state / joint_action are joint space. info.json names are opaque ('state', 'joint_state'): layout from shapes + stats. Gripper 0-1, 1 = open in this copy (episodes start and end at 1.0; original DROID uses 1 = closed).
droid.verified: droid_full info.json + stats.json + episode 0. rot6d order and gripper polarity inferred, unverified.

habit.frame: Dual Franka Panda, same layout as DROID per arm (two blocks). observation.state / action end-effector, joint_state / joint_action joint space; names opaque. Gripper 0-1, 1 = open (inferred).
habit.verified: habit_full info.json + stats.json + episode 0. Which block is the left arm, the EE frame and the rot6d order are unverified (action positions have outliers to +-7 m).

axes: arm A / B x y z

agibot26.frame: AgiBot G2 (robot_type agibot_g2a), two 7-DoF arms; layout as HABIT: 20-D end-effector state/action, 16-D joint state/action; plus waist_state (5) and arm_moving (2). Names opaque. Gripper 0-1, 1 = open (inferred).
agibot26.verified: info.json + stats.json + episode 0 of one task repo (task_3400_313498_314085); repos may differ. Arm order, EE frame and rot6d order unverified.

axes: arm A / B x y z

agibot_beta.frame: AgiBot A2D (robot_type agibot_a2d), same 20-D / 16-D layout as AgiBot World 2026; waist_state is 2-D (pitch, lift). Names opaque.
agibot_beta.verified: info.json + stats.json of agibot_beta_task_327 (its first-arm gripper is constant 0). Arm order, EE frame, rot6d order and units of lift unverified.

axes: arm A / B x y z

yam_sim.frame: Isaac YAM twin, joint space 14-D [L 6 joints, L gripper, R 6 joints, R gripper] (the policy space); action = absolute joint targets. Names opaque ('state'). Gripper 0-1; the sim resets state to all zeros, action gripper starts at 1.
yam_sim.verified: info.json + stats.json + episode 0 of pickbanana_dart05_1k_sq_real_x3 (left arm idle there). Gripper polarity in sim unverified.

webbed.frame: AnyData eef32 (absolute): both arms' end-effector pose, grippers and joints in one 32-D row; each arm in its own base frame, FK of the YAM grasp_site. Gripper 0-1, 1 = open (inferred).
webbed.verified: metadata_shared.json (state/action dim 32, absolute) + one lowdim shard of kitchen_put_spoon_seg48 (rotation rows orthonormal, grippers at 18-19, joints at 20-31); layout per the vendored AnyData converter (raiden_core.EEF32_LAYOUT).

axes: first two rows of the rotation matrix (row-major)
